purpose: Teach: 勝る/術後/検問/尊い/固有名詞/さなか/変ら/塵

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 新製品、競合に勝るとも劣らない、品質を目指せ。
lines.en: Aim for quality in the new product that matches or exceeds our competitors.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative delivery. Each phrase lands with weight. No padding—direct eye contact level throughout. The tone of someone used to being listened to.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員、術後復帰の支援制度、充実させました。
lines.en: Yes. We've strengthened our support program for employees returning after medical leave.
lines.style: Measured, respectful. Slight lean forward—showing he's attended to this personally. Steady pace, no rushing. The careful tone of someone reporting something he's proud of but won't oversell.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 内部監査、検問所のように、厳格に運用しろ。
lines.en: Internal audits need to run with the rigor of a checkpoint. Don't let anything slip through.
lines.style: Sharp, expectant. The final sentence cracks like a directive. Speaks with the assumption he'll be obeyed. Brief pause before the last phrase for weight.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員一人一人の命を、尊い財産として、扱っております。
lines.en: Yes. We treat each employee's wellbeing as something irreplaceable and valuable.
lines.style: Quiet conviction underneath. Slower pace than before—this matters more. Slight tremor of sincerity in the middle. Not performative, but unmistakably genuine. The voice of someone saying what he actually believes.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 契約書の固有名詞、誤記、見逃すな。
lines.en: Don't overlook typos in the contract names. Catch them all.
lines.style: Laser-focused, almost clipped. No warmth—this is a correction wrapped as a directive. The tone of someone who has seen small oversights become large problems.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。コロナのさなか、社員、力強く支えてくれました。
lines.en: Yes. During the pandemic, our staff supported us with real strength when it mattered most.
lines.style: Softer than usual. Slight reflection in the opening. Speaks with quiet respect for what was endured together. Warm but still professional—the acknowledgment of shared difficulty.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 創業精神、変らずに、引き継げ。
lines.en: Pass on our founding spirit unchanged. That's the inheritance we're giving them.
lines.style: Solemn, almost ceremonial weight. Speaks slower. This is legacy-talk, not instruction. A moment of genuine conviction that lifts the voice slightly. No rush to move on.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内、塵一つない清掃体制、徹底しております。
lines.en: Yes. We maintain rigorous cleaning standards throughout the office. Not a speck out of place.
lines.style: Finishing statement—slightly satisfied tone. Professional but warmer than the earlier replies. Speaks with the confidence of someone wrapping up something done well. Small exhale of completion at the end.
